audit_items.proof_trace: `change_obligation_reward_manager_share` first calls `update_obligation_reward_manager` which accrues rewards using the current (old) `obligation_reward_manager.share` before overwriting it with `new_share` (lines 217 then 221-224). The reward system tracks its own position in `obligation_reward_manager.share` independently of `obligation.ctokens`; reward accrual always uses the old share, so the invariant holds at the reward-manager layer. The Phase 02c 'CRITICAL' note confused two separate position representations — `handle_mint` changing `obligation.ctokens` is irrelevant to the reward accrual path.
